description: List the character sheets in the FilmLab cast register (id, name, age, gender, project_name, prompt_prefix_en). Call this BEFORE lab_generate whenever a person must look the same across several images: pass the id you find here as `character_refs` instead of re-describing the person in every prompt. Optional `search` matches name or project name (substring, case-insensitive). It shows YOUR OWN characters plus the public catalog (sheets explicitly made public and bound to no project). Characters of other accounts' projects never appear — projects can be confidential. New characters are private. The register returns at most 50 sheets, newest first, and offers NO paging — 20 are shown here. `total` therefore counts at most 50: with more than 50 sheets it understates, and `search` is the only way to reach the older ones. Nobody there yet? Create a sheet with lab_create_character.

preview.description: Attach each sheet's reference portrait, downscaled to 512px. A cast list read as text is a list of names; seen as faces it is a cast. At most 4 per call. A sheet WITHOUT a reference image shows none — and that is the same emptiness lab_generate rejects, so an absent picture here is a finding, not a glitch.

search.description: Substring of the character name or project name (case-insensitive)
